scripts.selfcheck:race-natural-weapons: tsx src/shared/dnd/raceNaturalWeapons.selfcheck.ts && node --input-type=module -e "import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs'; const j=JSON.parse(readFileSync('../backend/data/races/mpmm_race_catalog_spec.json','utf8')); const a=j.races.find(r=>r.slug==='aarakocra'); if(a?.natural_weapons?.[0]?.damage!=='1к4') { console.error('spec aarakocra talons must be 1к4'); process.exit(1);} console.log('spec aarakocra talons=1к4 ok');"
